sections.The setup: Dry April–June, successive heatwaves; hottest June–July on record.
sections.What amplified it: Dry soils intensified heat; fires in SW France and Spain; western Mediterranean up to 6 °C above normal.
sections.Climate signal: ~2 °C of Mediterranean warming is human-caused; marine heat virtually impossible pre-industrial (WWA).
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
